# Isaiah Chapter 64 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 12 verses]*

*Rend the heavens; mountains quake; no eye has seen; we are the clay; righteous deeds like filthy rags*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** We are the clay, and you are our potter; we are all the work of your hand. This chapter rend the heavens.

*-- LOGOS*
